blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — A 37-year-old suspect identified as the stepfather of a two-year-old boy who died after being found unresponsive inside their rented room in Barangay Tisa, Cebu City, denied beating the child, as the boy’s family said it would pursue a murder case against him. Police arrested alias “Lyle” at around 9:30 p.m. on Wednesday, September 16, in Sitio Nazareth, Barangay Buhisan, Cebu City, several hours after the child was found unresponsive inside their rented room along Santan Street. The boy was rushed to the Cebu City Medical Center but arrived without signs of life, according to the initial […]...
